status_detail: Explicitly selected and activated by the human after completion of the one-dimensional impurity follow-on chain and the accepted periodic-2D parent. The human response `stage A accepted, authorize managed closeout` resolved checkpoint RM-IMPURITY-DEFECT-2D-STAGE-A-ACCEPTANCE-HC02 and accepts that exact synthetic evidence boundary. This task remains active and selected. The human response `continue` resolved RM-IMPURITY-DEFECT-2D-STAGE-B-IMPLEMENTATION-HC03 and authorized execution-free Stage B implementation only. Authored nearest-neighbour toy behavior then exposed an incompatibility among the frozen generic twist, componentwise [0,1) twist reduction, and bare-permutation full-Hamiltonian D4 covariance. The human response `recommendation authorized` resolved RM-IMPURITY-DEFECT-2D-STAGE-B-TWIST-GAUGE-HC04 to ADOPT_MULTIROUTE_DATA_COMPLETE_EXECUTION_FREE_IMPLEMENTATION. The adopted implementation now has two independent matrix constructors, one explicit gauge bridge, fresh-process A-then-B and B-then-A schedules, complete retention of all 2,304 blind candidates, a closed result schema, a deterministic SVG plotter, and an independent verifier that does not import the runner. The clean authored toy is schedule invariant, the deliberately shared-cache mutation is discriminating, and all maintained software-verification tests pass. At that execution-free boundary, no accepted-parent Stage B result existed. The human authorized HC05, but its one execution attempt failed in 0.14 seconds before reading the design or accepted inputs because ../calculations arguments were interpreted against the repository root; no result was created and the failure is retained. HC06 authorized one corrected-path retry, which passed authority and path checks but stopped during parent-schema parsing before hopping or matrix construction because fixed lambda_x and lambda_y values were read from the wrong owning record; no result was created. The parser is corrected and read-only parent checks pass. The human authorized HC07. Its one schema-corrected attempt completed in 2.50 seconds, retained all 72 known-map route evaluations, 36 bridge records, and 2,304 blind candidates, and reported no failed runner criterion. Independent Fourier/seam reconstruction reports PASS for reconstruction and criteria with maximum difference 7.845e-13. Gamma and generic blind cases retain the expected unresolved-map ambiguity counts 512 and 64 per route and schedule. The human response `recommendation authorized` resolved RM-IMPURITY-DEFECT-2D-STAGE-B-ACCEPTANCE-HC08, accepts the exact HC07 calculated synthetic Stage B evidence, and authorizes managed closeout only. Accepted-parent execution, all work on Stages C-E, material-specific DFT, production Wannier90, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, material transfer, publication, release, deposit, and external transmission remain unauthorized.
